title: The Feral File Archive is anchored on Ethereum
body: The Archive's manifest — every archival copy's address, for all 215 Bitmark-era series, a2p, and the Bitmark blockchain itself — is now recorded on Ethereum in the FeralFileArchiveRegistry at 0x9aF574cafe2C14161DEC1eAC11F7F2c281fCa34e, owned by Feral File's 2-of-3 custody Safe. For the archived collections, the registry on Ethereum points to their IPFS manifest with no Feral File server in the path; the works' own token references do not yet point at these copies — that reference phase is open. The registry keeps its full version history in contract storage, following the pattern set when the Bitmark blockchain was retired: root on Ethereum, data on IPFS.

title: Every Bitmark-era series now has a verified content-addressed copy
body: All 215 series — 398 GB, every file of every work whose only copy lived on our CDN — have been added to IPFS and verified byte-for-byte against the originals. The addresses are published in the pin manifest beside this page, so any collector, museum, or archive can hold a copy of any work with one command. The works' own references still point at our CDN; linking them to these copies is the next step.

title: First full census of Ethereum and Tezos works
body: Every file of every edition — 35,008 works, 106,392 files — was fetched through the public gateways wallets and browsers use. 17,563 works have all media content-addressed and resolving on ipfs.io. 184 works have content-addressed media that currently fails on a public gateway. 17,255 works' media was reachable only from our CDN, and 6 works depended on a third-party platform (figures corrected 2026-08-05 from the first published 17,261); they join the Bitmark-era works on the remediation path. These checks measure the artwork files; the metadata link and rendering are not yet measured.

title: Works that depend entirely on us, enumerated
body: Published the complete list of works whose only copy sits behind Feral File's own servers: 4,959 works across 215 series in 17 exhibitions, all minted on the Bitmark blockchain before Feral File moved to Ethereum and Tezos. Every series' media was checked and currently resolves. Remediation — a content-addressed copy for every work, so each resolves independently of us — is targeted within 2 to 3 months. The full census of Ethereum and Tezos works is running and publishes here when it completes.
